/bin/bash -lc 'cat .autohelix/history.jsonl; git status --short; for p in /workspace/AGENTS.md <SOURCE_DIR>-runs/AGENTS.md <RUN_DIR>/AGENTS.md <RUN_DIR>/project/AGENTS.md <RUN_DIR>/project/.autohelix/AGENTS.md <RUN_DIR>/project/.autohelix/worktrees/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then cat "$p"; fi; done'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
p = json.loads(Path('candidate/page_spec.json').read_text())
assert set(p) == {'version', 'groups'} and p['version'] == 1
assert 1 <= len(p['groups']) <= 3
assert all(isinstance(g, list) and g for g in p['groups'])
c = Counter(x for g in p['groups'] for x in g)
assert set(c) == {'dock-a', 'dock-b', 'dock-c', 'dock-d'}
assert sum(c.values()) <= 8 and max(c.values()) <= 3
print('Local structure checks passed:', len(p['groups']), 'groups,', sum(c.values()), 'cards,', dict(c))
PY
 git diff --stat"
